question: Which of the following was the focus of the National Workshop held at Gujarat University, organised by the Ministry of Minority Affairs in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jainism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **July 2025**, the **Ministry of Minority Affairs**, Government of India, organized a high-level **National Workshop** at **Gujarat University**, **Ahmedabad**, specifically focusing on the **Jain community**.
 
• The primary objective of this workshop was to discuss the **preservation**, **digitization**, and **promotion** of **Jain manuscripts** and ancient texts which represent a significant portion of India's intellectual heritage.
 
• The event highlighted the **contribution of Jainism** to Indian philosophy, ethics, and the **Prakrit language**, seeking to integrate these traditional values with the modern educational framework.
 
• It served as a platform for **scholars**, **monks**, and **academicians** to deliberate on the development of specialized centers for Jain
